notes.text: INIS has stated explicitly that it is not possible to remain in Ireland for 90 days and then immediately re-enter for a further 90-day period. Repeat maximum-duration stays are subject to officer discretion and are not calculable by a tool.
A valid Irish transit visa is required when passing through Ireland in transit to another country. A transit visa does not permit the holder to leave the port or airport or otherwise enter Ireland.
